Lines.en: So we've met again, again! After all this chaos, CHAOS!
Lines.zh: 咱们又见面了，又见面了！经历了这么多混乱——混乱！

Lines.en: You've been highly dependent on that stupid conveyor belt and plants delivered by your stupid neighbours, heh?
Lines.zh: 你们一直死守着那条蠢得不行的传送带，还有那些傻邻居送来的植物，是吧？

Lines.en: I wonder what will happen......if I send my Zombot Historical-tron 1.0 to your past lawn and erase your existence from the very start!
Lines.zh: 我很好奇……如果我把我的历史重塑者1.0送回你们过去的草坪，从最一开始就把你们彻底抹除，会怎么样呢！

Lines.en: The lunatic shall be erased by the paradox along with the genius neighbours! Wahahaha!
Lines.zh: 就让那个疯子，连同那些天才邻居一起，被悖论彻底抹去吧！哇哈哈哈！

Lines.en: Alert! I detect some extremely specific timeline turbulence!
Lines.zh: 警报！我检测到时间线出现了极度异常的波动！

Lines.en: Dr. Zomboss has sent a Zombot back to Ancient Egypt! If our past selves fail to escape Ancient Egypt, then we won't be here, and we'll be erased once and for all!
Lines.zh: 僵王博士把一台机甲送回了古埃及！如果我们过去的自己没能逃出神秘埃及，那我们现在就不会存在于此，我们将被彻底抹除！

Lines.en: Penny! Let's smack that Zombot just like how we used to back in the good old days!
Lines.zh: 潘妮！咱们去揍扁那台僵王机甲，就像以前那些好日子一样！

Lines.en: Then...... who will supply our neighbour with——
Lines.zh: 那……谁来给我们的邻居提供——

Lines.en: Let's get it going before it's too late!
Lines.zh: 咱们赶紧出发吧，不然就来不及啦！

StringMultiLanguage.en: Just as expected! The two of us, left alone in the midst of this catastrophe!
StringMultiLanguage.zh: 果然不出所料！就剩我们俩了，孤零零地被困在这场灾难的正中央！

StringMultiLanguage.en: Now there's no more Crazy Dave delivering plants for you via the Conveyor Belt!
StringMultiLanguage.zh: 现在可没有疯狂戴夫给你往传送带上放植物了！

StringMultiLanguage.en: Give up already! You are no different from a fly caught in a well-planned web!
StringMultiLanguage.zh: 趁早放弃吧！此刻你就是个被天罗地网抓住的无头苍蝇！

StringMultiLanguage.en: Wh-what? How did that get there?
StringMultiLanguage.zh: 什-什么？哪来的爆炸坚果？

StringMultiLanguage.en: Wh-what? Aaarrrgh! I'll have to play this seriously!
StringMultiLanguage.zh: 什-什么？既然这样，那我也要认真了！
